Staff Vacancy
Thursday, 10 October 2024
3965 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram invites applications for the followings post in the prescribed proforma
(
download here
).
The application along with all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of:
The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS), 442102
latest by 26
th
October 2024.
1.
Administrative Officer-2 (Open-1 & SC-1)
Qualification & Experience
: Must be a Graduate in Science/Arts/ Commerce/Law of an Indian University or equivalent, person with Master in Business Administration or degree/diploma in Health management will be preferred & must have at least ten years experience of administration and supervision with five years experience in a large multi-specialty hospital or in a medical college, has to assist Senior Officers in all administrative work, handle legal matters, should have a very good communication skill in English in writing, should have knowledge of computers and proficiency in Marathi.
Medical Officer- 2 (Open-1 & SC-1)
Qualification & Experience
: (i) BAMS of a recognized University or Statutory State Board/Council of equivalent recognized under the Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970 (48 of 1970).  (ii) Enrolment in State Register or Central Register of Ayurveda.
Candidates with more than 5 years previous experience of working in 700 bedded Hospital out patient department and M.J.P.J.A.Y. scheme will be preferred.
Office Superintendent : 1 post (Open)
Qualification & Experience
: Must be a Post-graduate of an Indian University & at least 5 years’ experience in the Supervisory capacity in a Medical Institution / Hospital with more than 500 beds. Candidate with degree / diploma in Hospital Administration will be preferred. Has to assist Senior Officers in preparing various types of reports and correspondence with Government agencies. Have a very good communication skill in English & Marathi, proficiency in computer application with MSCIT / equivalent qualification.
Laboratory Technician : 1 post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
B.Sc. with DMLT from Govt. recognized Institute approved by State Technical Board / University with at least 2 years’ experience in a Medical College / Hospital with 300 or more beds.
Laboratory Assistant: 1 post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
HSSC (Science) with DMLT from Govt. recognized Institute with 2 years’ experience in a Medical College / Hospital with 300 or more beds.
Radiotherapy Technician : 2 Post (1 VJNT & 1 Open)
Qualification & Experience:
B.Sc/ M.Sc.( Physics)/ Advance Diploma of Radiotherapy Technology from a recognized institute/ University Approved by AERB
Dresser (Female) : 1 post (Open)
Qualification & Experience
: SSC/HSC with Diploma/ Certificate Course First Aid /ANM experience in Surgical dressing.  Required One-year experience in minimum 100 bedded Hospital.  Person with higher qualification & experience will be given preference.
Note :
Salary as admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society
Age between 18-38 years for open category/ between 18-43 years for reserved category.
Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written/ Skill test and shortlisted candidate will be called for document verification/ interview.
Number of post may vary.
Society reserves right to reject any or all application as deemed appropriate.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final & binding.
Only female candidates are eligible to apply
for the post of Dresser.
No TA and DA will be paid by Kasturba Health Society for attending the interview.
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
